{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Dakota Pipeline''' is a shelved natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Williston, North Dakota to Moorhead, Minnesota.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/17259555/wbi-proposes-bakken-natural-gas-pipeline|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''WBI Energy Transmission Inc<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/17270705/wbi-launches-dakota-natural-gas-pipeline-open-season|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''400 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/17259555/wbi-proposes-bakken-natural-gas-pipeline|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''375 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/17270705/wbi-launches-dakota-natural-gas-pipeline-open-season|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/17259555/wbi-proposes-bakken-natural-gas-pipeline|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Shelved<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2013<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/17259555/wbi-proposes-bakken-natural-gas-pipeline|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$650,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/17259555/wbi-proposes-bakken-natural-gas-pipeline|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
